note: 0.4: tank-gun KE rows of 100mm and larger. PenetrationAtMinRange is set to PenetrationAtGroundRange + close_range_bonus. Penetration falls in a straight line from that value at point blank to the long-range value at max range. dev.1 used a bonus of 0; dev.2 uses 50 (Osama, 5 November 2026). Non-MBT users of these rows: M8 AGS, M8 Thunderbolt, Stryker MGS, Sprut-SD, M10 Booker, BMOP Toros.
